metadata.displayed_class_rule: Top8 categories by sum of actually used class evidence u across active tiers, ties by class ID; displayed in class-ID order. No CE selection of categories.
metadata.case_rule: Retrospective outcome selection across BOTH original cohorts. Require valid, actual nonzero fusion, >=2 shared receiver classes, positive CE gain exceeding shuffled and L2 in BOTH metrics. Rank by number of memory numerical-term controls outperformed in BOTH metrics, then shared receiver class count, total source class support, earliest round and lowest receiver ID; never rank by maximum CE gain.
metadata.linkage: Panel c illustrates R0; panel d evaluates the full modified-region union. No R0-specific causal utility attribution.
metadata.memory_control_semantics: Original valid class/history mask held fixed; no_sm = mean(rho*d), no_rm = mean(min(d,a)); not retrained memory-free methods.
metadata.probe_scope: SGD training-side, disjoint from scoring samples; not an independent validation set.
metadata.figure_scope: Selected beneficial mechanistic example, not an unbiased1000-round mean or proof of overall efficacy.
